node.statement: The affine evaluation map (t,U_0,U_1) maps continuously to Z_t by the Banach-space operations, and u_delta is C^1, hence continuous, on the open set S_delta by lem-stage1-polar-retraction. Therefore their composition H is jointly continuous on the displayed admissible parameter domain. Also Z_0=U_0 and Z_1=U_1, and lem-stage1-polar-retraction gives u_delta(U_i)=U_i, so H joins U_0 to U_1.
